'''''Jev''''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] that was at the [[Sensor Control]] station. When the station was under [[Battle of the Anoat Main Sensor Array|attack]] and the shields began to fail. The shuttle carrying several Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] left the station in an attempt to escape but it was destroyed before it could jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
